title: Writing a Message With a Body
objective: Commit with a subject and a body, then print each part of the message.
hint: Make the README and git add it. Then git commit -q -m "Add practice notes" -m "Notes for the practice repository." with two -m switches. Then Write-Output Subject: with $(git log -1 --format=%s), and Body: with $((git log -1 --format=%b).Trim()).
